name: Bier Pioniere

endCondition.description: A player reaching 20 VP triggers the end; the round is completed, then final scoring.

categories.label: Victory points on track
categories.hint: VP marker position when the game ends, before final scoring.

categories.label: Final scoring 1: beer tiles discarded
categories.hint: 1 VP per beer tile discarded from the cellar, up to your lightbulb icons in your card display (icons are not spent).

categories.label: Final scoring 2: coins paid
categories.hint: Only if you reached the last space of the brewing level track: pay 1 coin per lightbulb icon for 1 VP each.

categories.label: Beer on hand (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Số bia còn lại (phân định hòa)
categories.hint: All beers: in cellar and not yet brewed, counted after final scoring.

categories.label: Barrels on brewery board (tiebreak)
categories.hint: Including the virtual barrel from the improved barrel depot.

tiebreakers.description: Tied player with more beer (cellar plus not-yet-brewed) wins
Then more barrels on the brewery board (incl. virtual barrel from improved barrel depot)
If still tied, the players tied at that point share the victory.

notes: family: running-track + end conversions. Nearly all points are tracked on the VP track during play (deliveries, objectives, first-builder bonuses); the scorer enters the track value plus the two final-scoring conversions. Other editions/expansions (e.g. Kölsch) not modelled.

sources.title: Bier Pioniere / Beer Pioneers rulebook
sources.section: p.29 End of the game: final scoring parts 1 and 2, winner and tiebreakers; 20 VP end trigger
